content: Cross-repo agent context 2026: Mabl 850-line Repo Coordination Graph reduced context drift from ~40% of agent failures to <5% (dependency graphs, topic maps, table ownership, release ordering). Riftmap productizing cross-repo dependency mapping (team/enterprise, code-graph centric). Individual practitioners use meta-repo pattern (AGENTS.md map + submodules) and self-report doc drift risk + manual maintenance burden. GitHub community open feature requests for Copilot cross-repo context — unmet by platforms. Confirms gap: no personal-level document-layer contract subscription tool.
